comparison_against_existing_model.candidate: Brasher-Kingsbury water uptake derived from the same single-frequency bytes
comparison_against_existing_model.existing: ISO 16773 low-frequency |Z| barrier metric (already receipted by this module in eis-rustcreep-crossmodality-v1 and eis-reproducibility-discrimination-power-v1)
comparison_against_existing_model.result: the candidate is NOT an improvement and NOT even admissible: it is rank-redundant with |Z| (T2), violates its own physical preconditions (T1), produces impossible values (T3), shows no Fickian time signature (T4), and is buried under the panel-to-panel noise floor (T5). The module correctly retains |Z| as its only single-frequency barrier descriptor.

data_source.author: Brian Baumgarten
data_source.rights: US Federal Government work, public domain (17 U.S.C. 105)

does_not_close: No coating-efficacy, product-performance, batch-release, or corrosion-rank authority.
Does NOT refute Brasher-Kingsbury as physics; it refutes its APPLICABILITY to a single-frequency 0.01 Hz summary. The law remains the correct target once frequency-resolved spectra are available.
The 6 passivity-violating rows are reported, not repaired: this cron holds no authority to edit or re-issue the upstream USBR bytes.

Phase-1 water-uptake capability requires frequency-resolved Z'(f), Z''(f) sweeps with a high-frequency (>= 1 kHz) coating-capacitance plateau, Kramers-Kronig / linear-KK residual validation, a pre-immersion dry C_0, and specimen area + dry-film thickness.
headline: First physical-admissibility audit of the Brasher-Kingsbury (1954) coating water-uptake law against this module's single-frequency EIS substrate (USBR-21019, 306 records, 6 coating systems x 4 baths). H0 REFUTED on 6 of 6 independent physical screens. (T0) 6/306 records (1.96%) carry |phase| > 90 deg and are IMPOSSIBLE for any passive cell -- a previously undetected integrity defect localized to 1 source file(s). (T1) median dissipation factor 0.74: only 14.3% of records are capacitance-dominated, so no coating capacitance can be read at 0.01 Hz. (T2) log10 C_eff is Spearman -0.9921 with log10|Z| -- rank-redundant, zero new information. (T3) only 51.1% of derived water uptakes are physically plausible; 26.1% are negative and 3.0% exceed the film volume (max 3.83). (T4) only 1/36 series are monotone; the weak aggregate time drift (post-anchor rho +0.157, perm p=0.01065) is not system-robust (95% CI [-0.19, 0.50]), so no Fickian uptake trajectory is identified. (T5) panel-to-panel reproducibility propagates to sigma(phi_v)=0.67 volume fraction, 2.2x the entire 0-30 vol% physical range. Conclusion: the module's declared Kramers-Kronig / equivalent-circuit abstention is now quantitatively EVIDENCED, not merely asserted; |Z| remains the only defensible single-frequency descriptor.
hypothesis_H0: The USBR-21019 single-frequency 0.01 Hz EIS summary admits a valid Brasher-Kingsbury (1954) reduction to coating water uptake, and that uptake carries barrier information beyond |Z| alone.

T0_passivity_screen.meaning: These rows cannot be produced by any passive electrochemical cell; they are instrument/processing artifacts in the published summary. They are localized, not diffuse, so the defect is a cell-level acquisition fault rather than a global convention error. Any Kramers-Kronig or equivalent-circuit fit that ingested them would be silently invalid.
T0_passivity_screen.principle: passive LTI two-terminal immittance requires Re{Z}>=0 <=> phase in [-90,+90] deg (B2)

T1_capacitive_dominance.meaning: At 0.01 Hz the median dissipation factor is 0.736: the response is resistively dominated, i.e. the charge-transfer / diffusion branch, not the coating dielectric. Only 14.3% of records sit in the capacitance-dominated regime where a coating capacitance can be read off at all.
T1_capacitive_dominance.principle: Brasher-Kingsbury presumes C is the COATING capacitance => the immittance at the extraction frequency must be capacitance-dominated, D=|cot(phi)|<<1 (B1,B3)

T2_information_redundancy.meaning: |rho| = 0.9921. The single-frequency 'capacitance' is a near-perfect monotone rescaling of the impedance modulus already receipted under ISO 16773, so it carries essentially ZERO additional rank information. This is expected: with one frequency, C_eff = -1/(2 pi f |Z| sin phi) and phi varies over a far narrower dynamic range than |Z| (which spans 6.5 decades).
T2_information_redundancy.principle: if C_eff is a monotone restatement of |Z| it can add no barrier information

T3_brasher_kingsbury_range_admissibility.C0_caveat: USBR provides no pre-immersion (dry) reading, so C_0 is already partly wetted; this biases phi_v LOW and therefore makes the admissibility test CONSERVATIVE (it can only under-count violations of the phi_v<0 kind).
T3_brasher_kingsbury_range_admissibility.C0_convention: earliest-date reading of each (coating system, replicate panel, bath) series
T3_brasher_kingsbury_range_admissibility.meaning: Only 51.1% of Brasher-Kingsbury values land in the physically plausible 0-30 vol% band; 26.1% are NEGATIVE (net water expulsion relative to the first immersion reading) and 3.0% exceed 1.0 (more absorbed water than the entire film volume). The maximum is 3.83, i.e. 383% water by volume.
T3_brasher_kingsbury_range_admissibility.note_area_free: the law uses only the capacitance RATIO, so the missing USBR specimen area and film thickness cancel exactly and cannot excuse this failure

T4_fickian_time_consistency.anchor_exclusion: the t0 point (phi_v == 0 by construction, and the earliest date) is EXCLUDED; including it would manufacture a positive time-rank correlation out of the definition of the estimator
T4_fickian_time_consistency.estimator: mean over series of Spearman rho(phi_v, immersion days)
T4_fickian_time_consistency.hostile_null: within-series permutation of phi_v against date order
T4_fickian_time_consistency.meaning: Only 1 of 36 panel-bath series are monotone non-decreasing (2.8%). A weak aggregate positive drift may be present -- mean post-anchor time-rank rho +0.157, permutation p=0.01065 -- so apparent capacitance does creep upward with exposure. But that drift is NOT robust to clustering by coating system (95% CI [-0.192, 0.497]) and is nowhere near the monotone approach-to-equilibrium a Fickian sorption curve requires. The honest reading is a weak, system-inconsistent drift consistent with progressive coating degradation (which also lowers |Z|), NOT an identified water-uptake trajectory.
T4_fickian_time_consistency.principle: Fickian sorption from a constant-activity reservoir is monotone non-decreasing in time toward equilibrium (Crank 1975, Ch.4)

T5_noise_floor_propagation.estimator: matched (system,bath,date) duplicate-panel log10(C) differences; the shared exposure-time trend cancels exactly, so this is a pure panel-to-panel term
T5_noise_floor_propagation.meaning: One standard deviation of panel-to-panel reproducibility maps to 0.666 volume fraction of apparent water uptake, i.e. 67 vol%. The entire physically admissible range of coating water uptake is 0-30 vol%. The measurement noise floor is 2.2x the whole signal range, so even a perfectly specified Brasher-Kingsbury extraction on these bytes would be unresolvable.
T5_noise_floor_propagation.principle: ISO 5725-2:2019 between-panel reproducibility propagated through the Brasher-Kingsbury law (B1,B5)
T5_noise_floor_propagation.propagation: sigma(phi_v) = sqrt(2) * sigma_log10C / log10(80); the sqrt(2) is because phi_v differences TWO independent capacitance reads (C_t and C_0)

theory_baselines.citation: Brasher D.M. & Kingsbury A.H., J. Appl. Chem. 4(2):62-72 (1954)
Boukamp B.A., J. Electrochem. Soc. 142(6):1885-1894 (1995); Macdonald J.R., J. Electroanal. Chem. 193:57-74 (1985); Barsoukov & Macdonald, Impedance Spectroscopy 2nd ed., Wiley 2005
theory_baselines.law: passivity: Re{Z}>=0 => phase in [-90,+90] deg (Kramers-Kronig prerequisite)

theory_baselines.citation: Barsoukov & Macdonald, Impedance Spectroscopy, 2nd ed., Wiley 2005, Sec. 1.2
theory_baselines.law: Z'=|Z|cos(phi); Z''=|Z|sin(phi); C_eff=-1/(2 pi f Z''); D=|cot(phi)|

theory_baselines.citation: Crank J., The Mathematics of Diffusion, 2nd ed., Oxford 1975, Ch. 4
theory_baselines.law: Fickian plane-sheet sorption is monotone non-decreasing to equilibrium

what_this_changes: The README's blanket abstention ('Kramers-Kronig and equivalent-circuit claims abstain unless a source contains frequency-resolved real/imaginary spectra') was a DECLARATION. It is now an EVIDENCED boundary with a quantified magnitude on each of five independent physical axes, plus a newly discovered integrity defect in the upstream public bytes (T0) that no prior audit of this module detected.
